next.duplicate: Check the existing grant in engine authorization; no duplicate submission is needed. This request has not issued a grant, and actual read access requires a separate check.
next.expired: This request will not continue issuance. Check existing grants first. If a new grant is still needed, a qualified handler must start a new request.
next.issued: The recipient may try Data Explorer. Current read access still depends on functional permission, validity, revocation and security conditions.
next.closed: Review the handling history below. Closing this request does not revoke other issued grants.
